title: The sunflower wanderer
description: A sculptural cat-shaped cup with an orange tabby, a sky-blue interior and an illustrated sunflower garden. A tiny landscape to carry into the everyday.
alt: Orange cat ceramic cup with a sunflower landscape
subtitle: Cat-shaped cup · A garden carried along

title: A striped little explorer
description: A striped cat becomes part of the cup itself. Bright flowers and a pale blue interior give this little companion its own world of colour.
alt: Striped cat ceramic cup with bright flowers and a blue interior
subtitle: Cat-shaped cup · A different travelling companion

title: A postcard from the clouds
description: Cloud-like blue and pink washes surround a small raised cat motif. An illustrated ceramic plate that feels like a postcard from a daydream.
alt: Blue, pink and white ceramic plate with a raised cat motif
subtitle: Illustrated plate · A tiny daydream

title: The slow afternoon
description: A floral cup, scalloped saucer and decorated spoon bring the valley to the table. Tiny cat details invite a closer look.
alt: Floral ceramic cup, scalloped saucer and spoon with small cat details
subtitle: Floral tableware · Time for a little pause

title: A gathering of stories
description: An ensemble of illustrated ceramic mugs in soft colours. Each little scene adds another page to the ceramic picture book.
alt: A group of pastel ceramic mugs with illustrated scenes
subtitle: Illustrated mugs · Companions for the everyday

title: A pocket-sized companion
description: A small ceramic cat detail on a beaded cord, bringing the idea of companionship into something you can carry with you.
alt: A small cat-themed ceramic pendant on a beaded cord
subtitle: Ceramic jewellery · A little valley to take with you
